hero.subtitle: Ten years owning a HIPAA-regulated platform serving 500,000+ patients, where a wrong answer was reportable rather than embarrassing. I also build the AI agent and evaluation infrastructure my own development runs on.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm Derek Kaneshiro, a principal software engineer in Hillsboro, Oregon. For ten years I owned the HIPAA-regulated platform behind Zimmer Biomet's orthopedic recovery products — 500,000+ patients, PHI in every request, accountable for its reliability throughout.
about.p2: I built the rules-driven engine that decides what each patient receives on each day of recovery; it became core product IP and still serves them. I replaced scattered per-endpoint permission checks with one centralized, auditable authorization model, because an auditor was going to ask who could write what and the architecture had to answer. And I led the R&D that prototyped Claude and Semantic Kernel integrations for that environment, taken through Architecture, Cloud, Security and risk governance.
about.p3: I also build the AI agent infrastructure my own development runs on: narrow composable sub-agents, MCP tool surfaces, and multi-provider routing selected per workload on accuracy, latency and cost — plus an evaluation framework I open-sourced, because AI systems degrade quietly and “it seems better” is not a measurement.
about.p4: Earlier I directed 30 engineers building the practice-management system for 750+ veterinary hospitals.

redy.tagline: Digital vault + EU DPP compliance platform
redy.description: Consumer app for managing receipts, warranties, and certificates. B2B platform for EU Digital Product Passport compliance ahead of the 2027 mandate. Document capture, OCR, sharing, and compliance reporting.

toknize.tagline: One API to tokenize anything, on any chain
toknize.description: Blockchain-agnostic tokenization platform. Create, manage, and transfer digital asset records with full provenance tracking across Sui, EVM, and Solana chains. Fractional ownership and multi-sig workflows.

stf.tagline: Open-source evaluation framework for AI systems
stf.description: Generates synthetic users, simulates behaviour, executes flows, scores results against custom quality metrics, and gates deploys on the outcome. Ships fab-mcp, an MCP server exposing every command as a native agent tool. MIT-licensed.
